questions.Text: Yes, thank you.  I've got some questions for you, if you've got time.

lost.Text: I'm not sure where to go from here.

jobe.Text: What can you tell me of the Jobe Research Program?

go_rk.Text: Wow, sounds exciting! Thanks for the information. Wish me luck!

go_rk_again.Text: Wow, sounds exciting! Thanks for the information. Wish me luck!

Text: {delay 1}I trust your trip from the Morningstar Space Station was a safe one.

help.Text: Absolutely.  That's what I'm here for.

Text: Well, I'm sure you've overheard conversations of the travellers while going through the Arrival Hall.
{delay 1}And perhaps you've also had a chance to chat with them.
{delay 1}Some of them have settled down on Rubi-Ka, and others have chosen to join the Jobe Research Program.
Due to heavy immigration and colonization of Rubi-Ka and the recent Alien attacks, security measures have been increased.
{delay 1}If you choose to immigrate to Rubi-Ka, you'll be shuttled to the ICC Shuttleport until background checks have been run and you can be granted proper citizenship.
{delay 1}The ICC Shuttleport is located in the ocean off the southern coast of terraformed Rubi-Ka.
{delay 1}While you're there, you'll also go through some basic orientation and training.

orientation.Text: You'll be given the opportunity to better familiarize yourself with the basics of Rubi-Ka wildlife, technology, and survival techniques.

rubika.Text: Hot, dangerous, and full of opportunity. The ICC Shuttleport is the place to learn your way around before you go planetside.

jobe.Text: The Jobe Research Program takes colonists through the Shadowlands door at the west end of the hall. The Jobe Research Scientist over there can tell you more.
